name: @unbrowse/ky-shim
description: Drop-in replacement for ky. A safe GET routes through Unbrowse's resolved-route cache ($0 on hit) and falls through to native fetch on miss — same callable default returning a ResponsePromise (json/text/blob/arrayBuffer/formData), get/post/put/patch/delete/head, create(), extend(), HTTPError.

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target node --format esm
